resolution.note: check, rules and budgets shipped in this PR

title: Turn the architecture-program run's lead mistakes into checks
body:
Outcome: the architecture-program run's lead mistakes become checks and rules: `krn task check` fails an open task ordered after an open task with a post-merge proof; lanes.md and lead-rules.md carry the measurement-population, shared-stash and long-run rules.
Why: after t-bs1ytt2 (open on purpose for a post-merge count) blocked two claims and lanes lost a run; measurement briefs lacked a named population; long runs as session subagents die with a handoff.
Proof: a regression test in test/task/task-check.test.ts; bin/krn task check passes on the repository; budgets in spec/context-budget.json record the real growth.
Scope: src/task/store.ts, test/task/task-check.test.ts, tasks/, .agents/skills/krn-lead/lanes.md, docs/program/lead-rules.md, spec/context-budget.json.
